cleavage_agent.evidence: Then, 5 µg Trypsin/Lys-C (in 125 µL 50 mM TEAB) were added to each sample and incubated overnight at 37°C.

fragmentation_method.evidence: After the survey scan, the 20 most abundant precursor ions (intensity ≥ 2.5 × 104 ions) were isolated in the quadrupole with an isolation window of a 1.6 m/z for high-collision dissociation fragmentation and fragment ions were recorded in the Orbitrap at a 15,000 resolution, AGC and maxIT were set to 5 × 104 and 150 ms, respectively.
